content.text: Fifty-Five (55) is an advanced, bidding-based variation of the Irish national card game Twenty-Five. Deeply rooted in rural Irish tradition, it is a descendant of the ancient game 'Spoil Five'. The game is famous for its intricate and 'arcane' card rankingsâ€”where the Five of Trumps is always the highest card and the Ace of Hearts is a permanent trumpâ€”and its unique requirement that players bid for the right to choose the trump suit.

Fifty-Five evolved from 'Maw' (16th century) and 'Spoil Five' (19th century). While Twenty-Five is the foundational version, Fifty-Five added the bidding layer to increase the strategic depth and scoring potential.
3 to 6 players. Usually played as individuals.
Standard 52ndcard deck. The Ace of Hearts is a special 'Perma-Trump'.
